verdict.rationale: Lium documents that GPU prices are public with no account or key needed. It has a public pricing page at lium.io/pricing, a CSV price feed, and a no-signup JSON feed of every rentable node, so no sales contact is required. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the pricing page lists a per-GPU-hour rate for every GPU type (it is a marketplace with node-level asks), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the page contents.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales
